raw_response:
I been farming this land 60 years. I do what my father did, what works. No school, but my hands know.

My 11.6 mu — I split like always. Maize take most, about 5.5 mu, it feed us and sell. Cotton 3 mu, that my cash. Peanut 2 mu, good for oil and the land rest better after. Mungbean 1.1 mu on the edge piece where soil thin.

Fertilizer I buy in bags at the town shop. For maize I put two bags compound 15-15-15 before plow, that about one bag per 3 mu, then urea top-dress when knee-high, one big bag for the maize field. Maize eat a lot, if I skimp the ear come small. My neighbor Old Wang cut fertilizer two year ago and cry when harvest come. Better spend the money.

Cotton need less nitrogen or it grow tall and no bolls. One bag compound per 2 mu, little urea at flower time. Cotton I spray many times — bollworm, aphid. Six, seven times through summer. Cannot save on spray or lose everything.

Peanut and mungbean are bean crop — they make their own nitrogen, my father told me. Just little compound fertilizer, mostly for the phosphorus to help pod fill. No urea.

Seeds — maize I buy hybrid from the shop, everybody do. Cotton also hybrid, the Bt kind, less worm. Peanut I keep my own seed from last year, save money. Mungbean same, my own seed.

Water from well — maize I water 3 time, before tassel most important. Cotton 2 time at flower and boll. Peanut 2 time. Mungbean 1 time if dry.

Tractor man come rotary till, 60 yuan per mu. I no own tractor.
